payload.title: Add the Pi coding agent as an Issue Router adapter
payload.description: Support the Pi coding agent (pi, npm package @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent) as a third router adapter beside codex and opencode, in both Python and Rust runtimes, spec first. Antigravity is not a router adapter in this repo (provenance name only) and is out of scope; provenance recognition of Pi and the container harness are deferred.
